verdict.rationale: Better Auth's security docs say a logged-in user can revoke their own sessions to log out from other devices or browsers, and it has a documented session-management concept, so user-side revocation is first-party. The admin plugin is described only as covering user creation, roles, banning and impersonation, with no explicit admin session listing or revocation. Missing for 10: documented listing of active sessions with device details, explicit revoke-all-sessions capability, admin-side session viewing and revocation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
